Vampirism
Instant
Teaches Embrace of the Vampyr, but disables the use of Curse of the Worgen.
Transgression
Enter a unique Cursed Form for 30 sec that does not disable the use of Mortal Form abilities and casts a free Vampiric Fang on your target.

While active, direct spell damage triggers a Vampiric Feast, dealing 20% additional Shadow damage to enemies, healing you equal to 50% of the damage dealt.

While in a Cursed Form you are treated as if you were a Demon.
